contributions.detail: One row, 90.00, equal to the cover's line-1 TOTALS FOR THIS REPORT cell (90.00) to the cent. The line-1 CUMULATIVE cell EXISTS on the form and the filer left it BLANK, and the LAST REPORT cell is blank too, so there is no printed cumulative anchor. Because the rows equal the THIS-REPORT figure and no cumulative figure is printed, scope is recorded as 'period' — the conservative call. The blank LAST column is consistent with this being the first report of the cycle (in which case period and cumulative would coincide), but the form does not state that and it is not asserted. The Carr form prints no schedule total.

expenditures.detail: Four rows sum to 454.72 (99.00 + 100.00 + 49.00 + 206.72), equal to the cover's line-3 TOTALS FOR THIS REPORT cell to the cent, and equal to a grand total the FILER hand-wrote and underlined on the writing line immediately below row 4 of Form B. That hand-written total is the filer's own addition, not a printed form field, so it is not transcribed as a row — but it is a genuine second anchor and it agrees. Line 3's CUMULATIVE and LAST cells are blank, so scope is 'period' on the same reasoning as the contributions side.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr 5-5-PG prints NO schedule total and NO page subtotal. p2: 1 row 90.00 = cover line 1 THIS (90.00). p3: 4 rows sum 454.72 = cover line 3 THIS (454.72) AND = the filer's own hand-written, underlined 454.72 below row 4. Both gates fire exact.
gates.row_count: Counted against INK. Form A: exactly 1 inked writing line (date, name, address, amount all present); every line below is empty — 1 row emitted. Form B: exactly 4 inked transaction lines plus a 5th inked line carrying ONLY an underlined amount (the filer's grand total, no date/payee/purpose) — 4 rows emitted, the total deliberately not transcribed as a row per core brief 6 ('an unlabelled figure under a schedule total is not a field'). Counts of dates/payees/purposes/amounts are 4/4/4/4 on Form B and 1/1/1/1 on Form A — field-shift screen passes.
gates.geometry_proof: p2 row-1 crop (pct 83.70,9.20,9.80,2.40) renders '90.00'; control one pitch below renders EMPTY. p3 row-1 crop (pct 82.50,10.30,11.00,2.20) renders '99.00'; row-4 crop (pct 82.50,17.30,11.00,2.20) renders '206.72'; the control one pitch below row 4 does NOT render empty — it renders the filer's hand-written grand total '454.72', which is the next inked line on the page. That is the truthful state of the page and confirms the row index is not shifted and that no fifth transaction exists.
gates.balance_chain: 90.00 - 454.72 = -364.72. Cover line 4 reads 364.72 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns, written WITHOUT a minus sign or parentheses (verified at 600 dpi). The magnitude closes exactly; the sign is the filer's omission and the figure is retained verbatim as '364.72'. Line 4 is also the ONLY line on which the filer filled the CUMULATIVE column. LAST REPORT column is blank on all four lines, so there is no prior filing to chain to.
